transcripts.text:
PIERRE CHOUTEAU
ST. LOUIS.

Sept.5, 1903.

Miss Mary Louise Dalton,
Missouri Historical Soey.,
St.Louis.

My dear Miss Dalton:--
I think the following will fully answer
your inquiries, but if locations, months and dates are desired, […]
many can be furnished.

Pierre Ligueste de Laclede-- born 1724, emigrated to
Louisiana 1755, founded St.Louis 1764, died 1778. I herewith
quote from notes to which I referred:

' The remainder of Laclede's life was spent in a strug-
gle for existence.-- He was respected and beloved by all with
whom he came in contact -- He gave his all, and died without
accumulation, for an enterprise that has resulted as he predicted,
'in one of the finest cities of America!' He died June 20th,1778,
at the mouth of the Arkansas river while en route from New Orleans
to St.Louis.

The following year an expedition was sent to recover his
body; much to the chagrin of those who undertook this sad mission,
they found the mighty Mississippi had eaten into its banks, and
claimed the mortal remains of Laclede as being worthy to repose
under its turbid waters, alongside that of De Soto.

Very truly yours,
Pierre Chouteau

Dictated.

Missouri Historical
Society
Saint Louis
